title: Just-in-Time Role Sculptor and Audit Sparkline Prototype
creator: Asha Patel
description: Summary: Design a compact, progressive-disclosure UI for creating and refining workspace roles (Role Sculptor) with an inline audit sparkline that surfaces recent access reviews and changes. The flow targets two personas: platform admins who do bulk role management and product security engineers who need fast context during incident investigation. Goals: 1) Reduce cognitive load when composing least-privilege roles by providing contextual templates and a stepper that narrows permissions with examples. 2) Enable quick verification of a role's recent activity via a 1-line audit sparkline and top-3 recent access events. 3) Support just-in-time (JIT) temporary grants from the same flow with clear expiry/approval metadata. Out of scope for this ticket: backend enforcement rules, enterprise policy engine integration; we will surface required fields and link to the policy editor in a follow-up.
acceptance_criteria: Role Sculptor draft screens (low-fi) in Figma with stepper and template chooser
Audit sparkline component added to role summary with tooltip showing last 3 events
JIT grant microflow documented and annotated for handoff
Design critique held and feedback incorporated into hi-fi prototype
research_summary: Interviewed 6 customers (security leads + platform engineers) — recurring need to see recent role usage when editing roles
Users preferred progressive templates over starting from blank role; templates reduced decision time in tests
Concerns surfaced about JIT visibility and auditability; must include approver, expiry, and link to audit log
decisions_and_tradeoffs: Chose progressive disclosure stepper to avoid overwhelming new admins
Removed inline time-range selector from sparkline to keep compact view; link opens full audit explorer
Implemented JIT as a first-class lightweight grant rather than modal escalation to keep context and reduce page switches
open_questions: How will Dedicated/Private customers prefer to store approver attestations (console only vs. external SSO)?
Should JIT grants auto-revoke on workflow completion or strictly by time expiry? Engineering to advise on feasibility
